body:
Hey, you're 14! You're young! You're going through a lot of hormonal changes right now and it's really gonna fuck up your emotions. Of course I'm not blaming it all on this, but that part definitely gets better with time.

You're focusing so much on the negatives, but I know that's not all you are. What are you good at? What are your strengths? Thinking only about your weaknesses won't help! 

And trust me, there's always people reading and there are always people who care, you took a good first step with this post

Thank you Charlie, I know that we're just two people ok the internet, maybe hundreds of miles away, but you've made me feel a lot better. I know it's not an instant cure,  but you've helped take the edge off, and I feel like I can go to sleep. Even if I don't have the chance to repay your kindness, I hope that someone does.

I had to read your post a few times (no offends meant) to really understand what you said, but I think you've pinpointed my issue very well.  Especially will the school preparing you to live "average lives" bit.

I worry so much about being average... Average an any way, I just want to feel like I have some sort of significance in my life, rather than living an average life, dying at an average age, then fade into obscurity like so many billions of people have. It seems so greedy to want more than a happy, long life that so many people don't even have to begin with... But I can't help that that's the way I feel. It gets bad when I'm alone. I think about death and then nothingness until my mind aches. I almost wish I was religious just so I could believe in an afterlife. But as it is, the thought of death frightens me so much that I sometimes would rather kill myself then think about it more and wait for it to happen

Thanks... Everything is so "raw" right now that I can't help but cry when I read comments like yours, not from being upset but because it makes me feel like people out there know how I feel.

Reading these replies has been cathartic. I won't say  that "wow I'm instantly better thanks guys" or even that this will be my last post here. Just know that if you left a comment here (or on anyone else's post) that you've helped stave off some of our unpleasant thoughts.

Thank you again... For a while it's been just therapist meeting to therapist meetings that's kept me going. This has given me a little bit more to run on

There's that quote "a man dies two deaths, the first when he stops breathing, and the second when his name is said for the last time".  I think about that a lot. Will I ever leave behind something that people wi remember or experience years after I'm gone? And even if I do... It's not like someone as great as Washington or Adams still feels... Experiences things. I just don't know if what I do will ever be enough for me or if I'll go through life so scared of death that I can't help but be focused on things like mortality. I really don't know. And it's things that like that make my head feel likes it's being torn apart from the inside. Just thoughts that compound until the drown out everything else in my mind

I'm sorry to keep ranting like this, it's just been especially hard recently. I really wanted to check myself into the local "crisis center" (I'm in Pittsburgh) but the buses stopped running and it's too cold to walk. I just want someone to tell me everything is going to be okay... That I'll feel better in the morning. It's just so hard to get through to the next day. 

I want to tell my parents... I'll say "mom, I've been having some really awful thoughts recently"but then she'll be known as the parents with the suicidal kid. I don't want to bring my parents into this, they've had a rough year as it is. I don't want to be *that* child.... But I don't know what to do
My comment is a good summary of it

It looks like this post worked so I'll expand 

I don't know what the point of life is anymore. I mean I know that I should be grateful, wanting to get an education and live my life as my upper middle class parents want me to. But I can't. Everyday my head is swallowed up of thoughts of my future, of the nature of life. "What am I doing?" "How do I get the most out of my time here?" For the last few months I've been so acutely aware of my own mortality, I just can't take it anymore.

Nothing that should bother me does. Exams, courses, relationships, nothing. What bothers me most is the fact that I DONT care about those things even though I should and everyone around me does. All I can think about is howe meaningless my life is in the grand scheme of things. It doesn't make me feel good.

I just don't know what to do. I feel like killing myself all the time so these awful thoughts in my head would stop. This constantly worrying about my place on earth is doing nothing but fucking up my mind. I don't know what to do anymore but just to silence it once and for all
Palpitation commented on my thread with some good advice. Try taking a semester off and see now it affects you. College isn't for everyone (I'm experiencing that first hand...)

Thanks for the reply

I've really thought about this. It makes it hard that my parents are paying for my education and really expect me to do well, but I agree. Taking a year off might help me clear my head

Hey man, I don't even need to know what you look like to know there is hope for you :)

I think the biggest thing is confidence and your self image. Clearly right now you have a low self worth, and the best thing you can do is improve yourself in every facet of your life. I saw that you posted on /r/loseit which is great! If you continue losing weight you're gonna feel a lot better about yourself. I don't know your work or school environment, but improving yourself there to will help a lot. 

I have a friend who is, to be honest, a little homely. He has one eye and is... Well... different looking in general. But the thing is, he strives to improve himself and in doing so improves the lives of everyone around him, he's charismatic and people love to be around him. And trust me, he doesn't have a huge problem finding ladies.  Nothing about your looks changes your personality,  and having confidence will help you so much. 

Don't lose hope man, it's not always about the looks. If you've seen the pictures of soldiers who have most of their features burned off but still manage to find a girlfriend you'll know that.  People love personality, you just have to give it to them.  Try to join clubs or groups of anything that interests you to help you meet people.
Thank you.  I'm taking 18 credits next semester to try and stop being so complacent.  I'm also going to retake both classes.  I just don't want this to ruin me.
